title: #42621: Dialog content overflows on short viewports
description: Dialog: when the viewport is shorter than its content, a dialog without .dialog-scrollable spills its content out of its box, and nothing scrolls to reach it.

files.README.md:
# #42621: Dialog content overflows on short viewports

Dialog: when the viewport is shorter than its content, a dialog without .dialog-scrollable spills its content out of its box, and nothing scrolls to reach it.

Upstream: https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/issues/42621

Bootstrap main at 2f63a73 (https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/commit/2f63a737635d9c8daea42bb5509f4fe81c0e6789), compiled from its source with this reproduction's config: `main.scss` (Sass options), `_custom.scss` (Sass rules) and `tokens.css` (CSS custom properties and rules).

```sh
npm install
npm run dev
```

Exported from https://github.com/julien-deramond/bootstrap-test-playground/tree/main/issues/42621
